title: Job: Oh, That I Knew Where I Might Find Him

questions.question: Today also my complaint is what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:2 (ESV): "Today also my complaint is bitter; my hand is heavy on account of my groaning."

questions.question: Oh, that I knew where I might find whom?
questions.explanation: Job 23:3 (ESV): "Oh, that I knew where I might find him, that I might come even to his seat!"

questions.question: I would fill my mouth with what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:4 (ESV): "I would lay my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments."

questions.question: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power?
options: No; he would pay attention to me
questions.correctAnswer: No; he would pay attention to me
questions.explanation: Job 23:6 (ESV): "Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No; he would pay attention to me."

questions.question: But he knows the way that I what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:10 (ESV): "But he knows the way that I take; when he has tried me, I shall come out as gold."

questions.question: When he has tried me, I shall come out as what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:10 (ESV): "when he has tried me, I shall come out as gold."

questions.question: My foot has held fast to his what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:11 (ESV): "My foot has held fast to his steps; I have kept his way and have not turned aside."

questions.question: I have not departed from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:12 (ESV): "I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my portion of food."

questions.question: But he is unchangeable, and who can do what to him?
questions.explanation: Job 23:13 (ESV): "But he is unchangeable, and who can turn him back? What he desires, that he does."

questions.question: Therefore I am terrified at his presence; when I consider, I am in dread of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 23:15 (ESV): "Therefore I am terrified at his presence; when I consider, I am in dread of him."

questions.question: God has made my heart what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:16 (ESV): "God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me;"

questions.question: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I do not what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:8 (ESV): "Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I do not perceive him;"

questions.question: On the left hand when he is working, I do not what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:9 (ESV): "on the left hand when he is working, I do not behold him; he turns to the right hand, but I do not see him."

questions.question: For he will complete what he appoints for me, and many such things are with whom?
questions.explanation: Job 23:14 (ESV): "For he will complete what he appoints for me, and many such things are with him."

questions.question: Yet I am not silenced because of the darkness, nor because thick darkness covers my what?
questions.explanation: Job 23:17 (ESV): "yet I am not silenced because of the darkness, nor because thick darkness covers my face."

key_verse_text: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tried me, I shall come out as gold.
